payload.definition: Acute physical and psychological symptoms of caffeine withdrawal. Distinct from general fatigue - includes headaches, irritability, difficulty concentrating, emotional volatility. Most intense in May-July period, fading by September.
payload.inclusion_criteria: Apply when describing specific withdrawal symptoms: headaches, heightened irritability, emotional dysregulation, cognitive fog beyond simple tiredness. Distinguish from adapted low-energy state.
examples: Headaches. Every afternoon. Like my head is in a vice
Irritable. Little things make me angry
